name: Codeberg (Forgejo API)
tier_rationale: Codeberg e.V., a non-profit association running a public Forgejo forge with published terms and a multi-year public track record (A8 community); P100 and P359 record 'Codeberg e.V. community'.

reliability.justification: Platform records are authoritative for accounts, organisations and repositories hosted on Codeberg; profile fields are self-asserted by their owners.

api.title: Codeberg Forgejo API v1 (users, users/search, orgs, org repos)

terms.quote: Registry: npm (GitHub), PyPI (PSF), DEV/Forem and Hugging Face tier trusted, Codeberg e.V. community; all terms open; personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P100 cond 8). P359 also lists Codeberg 'open'. /api/v1/users/{u} (404 = ABSENT), users/search?q=, orgs/{org}, orgs/{org}/repos?limit=50 (research C0245, C0760); repository archives only in the deep preset for secret scanning (P359). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G05-2, p2-G05-1, p2-G05-2: batches only extend it (codeberg__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Quota: observed ratelimit-policy 'baseline';q=2000;w=600, i.e. 2000 requests per 600 s (research C0245) -> rate 3.333/s (published false, 80% budget) and min_interval 0.5 s. Self-hosted Forgejo/Gitea instances are target infrastructure, never this provider (P100, P359). personal_data_review is still to be recorded (usernames, A3 BR8).
